nodes.rationale: Coordinator's landing view — roster size, upcoming activities, and quick access to the two things they actually do here: add students and schedule things.

nodes.rationale: Own-institution student roster — the Coordinator's working list to view or edit a student record.

nodes.rationale: Schedule an activity and mark who attended, for the Coordinator's own institution.

nodes.label: SCR-SCH-008 /school/teacher/students/[id]
nodes.rationale: One assigned student's attendance, career activities, and progress — read-only.

nodes.label: SCR-SCH-009 /school/parent (Dashboard: my children)
nodes.rationale: A Parent's view of their own child's — or children's — profile and progress, with a switcher if there's more than one.

nodes.label: SCR-SCH-010 /overseas/admin/schools
nodes.rationale: Every partnered school in one list, with a create-school form on the same screen — the Admin's one stop for onboarding a new partner or checking an existing one's Coordinator status.

nodes.label: SCR-SCH-012 /school/coordinator/team

nodes.label: SCR-SCH-013 /school/invite/[token]/accept
nodes.rationale: Turn an invite into a real, usable login in one step.

nodes.label: SCR-SCH-014 /school/academic-team (Dashboard: assigned students)
nodes.rationale: Every assigned student's result status at a glance — who still needs a result uploaded, who's Draft, who's Published.

nodes.label: SCR-SCH-015 /school/academic-team/results/new
nodes.rationale: Enter a result for one subject/term — it starts life as a Draft, invisible to everyone but Academic Team until verified and published.

nodes.label: SCR-SCH-016 /school/academic-team/results/[id]
nodes.rationale: Move a result forward — verify it, then publish it — and see its full history of who did what, when.

nodes.label: SCR-SCH-017 /school/career-counselor (Dashboard: assigned students)
nodes.rationale: Every assigned student, one list — the Career Counselor's starting point for adding a guidance session, a counselling note, or a recommendation.

nodes.label: SCR-SCH-018 /school/career-counselor/students/[id]/records
nodes.rationale: One student's whole career-guidance-and-counselling history, and the place to add to it.

nodes.label: SCR-SCH-019 /school/psychometric-team (Dashboard: assigned students)
nodes.rationale: Every assigned student, one list — who needs an assessment assigned, who has a report pending upload.

nodes.label: SCR-SCH-020 /school/psychometric-team/students/[id]/assessments
nodes.rationale: One student's assessments — assign a new one, or upload a report against one already assigned.

nodes.label: SCR-SCH-021 /overseas/admin/school-staff
nodes.rationale: Create an Academic Team, Career Counselor, or Psychometric Team account and assign the school(s) they cover — the only way any of these three accounts comes into existence.

nodes.rationale: One child's complete profile & progress — the `EVID-014` §23 list as far as confirmed modules can supply it.

nodes.label: SCR-SCH-023 /school/parent/notifications
nodes.rationale: The Parent's full notification feed — assessment assigned / report ready, guidance or counselling recorded, session scheduled, result Published.
